description: This header defines the API and data structures for sampling hashtables and collecting runtime statistics within the Abseil C++ library. It includes classes, functions, and mechanisms for managing sampled hashtable info, enabling/disabling sampling, and configuring sampling parameters.

classes.name: HashtablezInfo
classes.description: Stores runtime statistics and metadata about a sampled hashtable, including capacity, size, probe lengths, hash bitwise operations, and stack trace.

classes.name: HashtablezInfoHandle
classes.description: RAII handle for managing registration and deregistration of sampled hashtable info, with no-op implementation if sampling is disabled at compile time.

methods.name: RecordRehashSlow
methods.description: Records a slow rehash event with total probe length.

methods.name: RecordReservationSlow
methods.description: Records a slow reservation event with target capacity.

methods.name: RecordStorageChangedSlow
methods.description: Records a change in storage size and capacity.

methods.name: RecordInsertSlow
methods.description: Records an insert event with hash and distance from desired position.

methods.name: Sample
methods.description: Returns an RAII handle for sampling, based on sampling rate and global state.

methods.name: GlobalHashtablezSampler
methods.description: Provides access to the global hashtablez sampler instance.

methods.name: SetHashtablezConfigListener
methods.description: Sets a callback for configuration changes.

methods.name: SetHashtablezEnabledInternal
methods.description: Internal function to set sampling state.

methods.name: SetHashtablezSampleParameterInternal
methods.description: Internal function to set sampling rate.

methods.name: GetHashtablezMaxSamples
methods.description: Gets the maximum number of samples to keep.

methods.name: SetHashtablezMaxSamples
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of samples to keep.

methods.name: SetHashtablezMaxSamplesInternal
methods.description: Internal function to set max samples.
